Every named source directly linked: Groups msgid + mail-archive, both ISO standard pages (labelled paywalled), IANA registry (HEAD-checked 200), HTML Standard source-type anchor, jxl-rs repo, TAG review, Firefox release notes + bug, webstatus.dev, developer-signals issue, chromestatus feature link (invariant #3).
